title.ja: PERSES X% - EP. 1 | 「PERSES」ドキュメンタリー ❮10% 夢への挑戦❯

transcript.text: JIB, Hatai Sarawutpaiboon (GNEST Director): For the 5 youths whom we choose to become members of PERSES, JIB: I must say that in the beginning, we wanted to form a Boy Group consisting of 4-5 members and has its own character.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: サムラップ・デック・ターン・ハー・コン・ティー・ラオ・ルアック・マー・ペン・パーセス・ナ・クラップ・チャット・ジェーン・ルーイ・ワー・トーン・レーク・ラオ・ヤーク・タム・ボーイグループ・ティー・ミー・プラマーン・シー・トゥン・ハー・コン・ティー・ミー・カーラクテール
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB , Hatai Sarawutpaiboon (GNEST Director ): For the 5 youths whom we choose to become members of PERSES , JIB : I must say that in the beginning , we wanted to form a Boy Group consisting of 4 - 5 members and has its own character .

translations.ja: ジップ（GNEST取締役）：PERSESのメンバーとして選んだ5人の若者についてですが、当初から僕たちは独自の個性を持った4〜5人編成のボーイズグループを作りたいと考えていました。
translations.en: JIB, Hatai Sarawutpaiboon (GNEST Director): For the 5 youths whom we choose to become members of PERSES, JIB: I must say that in the beginning, we wanted to form a Boy Group consisting of 4-5 members and has its own character.
translations.ko: JIB, 하타이 사라웃파분 (GNEST 디렉터): PERSES의 멤버로 선택한 5명의 청소년들에 대해 말하자면, JIB: 처음에는 4~5명으로 구성되고 자신만의 색깔이 있는 보이 그룹을 만들고 싶었다고 말씀드리고 싶습니다.
translations.id: JIB, Hatai Sarawutpaiboon (Direktur GNEST): Untuk 5 pemuda yang kami pilih menjadi anggota PERSES, JIB: Harus saya katakan bahwa pada awalnya, kami ingin membentuk sebuah Boy Group yang terdiri dari 4-5 anggota dan memiliki karakter tersendiri.
translations.pt: JIB, Hatai Sarawutpaiboon (Diretor da GNEST): Para os 5 jovens que escolhemos para se tornarem membros do PERSES, JIB: devo dizer que no início queríamos formar um Boy Group composto por 4 a 5 membros e com personalidade própria.

transcript.text: JIB: We want the group to have a Gangster character and might not be so patterned. JIB: We also want members with appealing characters and attitudes.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ラオ・ヤーク・ダイ・クワーム・ペン・ギャングスター・ティー・アアット・チャ・マイ・ダイ・ペン・ペッターン・マーク・ヤーク・ダイ・コン・ティー・ミー・カーラクテール・ミー・アティチュード・ティー・ナー・ソンチャイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : We want the group to have a Gangster character and might not be so patterned . JIB : We also want members with appealing characters and attitudes .

translations.ja: ジップ：型にはまりすぎない、ギャングのような結束力やワイルドさを持ったグループにしたかったんです。魅力的な個性と強い意志を持ったメンバーを求めていました。
translations.en: JIB: We want the group to have a Gangster character and might not be so patterned. JIB: We also want members with appealing characters and attitudes.
translations.ko: JIB: 우리는 그룹이 갱스터 같은 캐릭터를 가졌으면 좋겠고 너무 정형화되지 않았으면 좋겠다고 생각했습니다. JIB: 또한 매력적인 캐릭터와 태도를 가진 멤버들을 원했습니다.
translations.id: JIB: Kami ingin grup ini memiliki karakter Gangster dan mungkin tidak terlalu kaku. JIB: Kami juga ingin anggota dengan karakter dan sikap yang menarik.
translations.pt: JIB: Queremos que o grupo tenha um estilo "Gangster" e talvez não seja tão padronizado. JIB: Também queremos membros com personalidades e atitudes cativantes.

transcript.text: JIB: If one asks about my first impression of them, I would say that they’re all different. JIB: For KRIT (KRITTIN), he lacked dancing skills when I first met him.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ター・ターム・トゥン・ファーストインプレッション・コーン・テーラ・コン・ナ・クラップ・タオ・ティー・ヘン・ゴー・テー・ターン・カン・パイ・モット・ルーイ・クリット・ニ・トーン・レーク・ティー・チャ・マイ・ミー・タークサ・ルアン・コーン・カーン・テン・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : If one asks about my first impression of them , I would say that they ’re all different . JIB : For KRIT (KRITTIN), he lacked dancing skills when I first met him .

translations.ja: ジップ：彼らの第一印象を聞かれたら、全員がまったく違っていたと答えますね。クリッティンは、最初に出会ったときはダンススキルが全然ありませんでした。
translations.en: JIB: If one asks about my first impression of them, I would say that they’re all different. JIB: For KRIT (KRITTIN), he lacked dancing skills when I first met him.
translations.ko: JIB: 그들에 대한 제 첫인상에 대해 묻는다면, 모두 다 달랐다고 말하고 싶습니다. JIB: 크릿(KRITTIN)의 경우, 처음 만났을 때는 춤 실력이 부족했습니다.
translations.id: JIB: Jika seseorang bertanya tentang kesan pertama saya terhadap mereka, saya akan mengatakan bahwa mereka semua berbeda. JIB: Untuk KRIT (KRITTIN), dia kurang dalam kemampuan menari saat pertama kali saya bertemu dengannya.
translations.pt: JIB: Se alguém me perguntar sobre minha primeira impressão deles, eu diria que são todos diferentes. JIB: Quanto ao KRIT (KRITTIN), ele não tinha habilidades de dança quando o conheci.

transcript.text: JIB: But when he sang, he was so charming. JIB: The moment I heard him sing, I was like…Woah, this person could grow into a talented artist.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テー・パー・カオ・ローン・ペー・レオ・カオ・ミー・サネー・マーク・ダイ・イン・パープ・ローン・クン・マー・レオ・ルー・スック・ワー・オホー・コン・ニー・プッタナー・ペン・シンラピン・ティー・ディ・ダイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : But when he sang , he was so charming . JIB : The moment I heard him sing , I was like …Woah, this person could grow into a talented artist .

translations.ja: ジップ：でも歌うとものすごく魅力的で。彼の歌声を聴いた瞬間、「うわあ、この子は素晴らしいアーティストに成長できる」と確信しました。
translations.en: JIB: But when he sang, he was so charming. JIB: The moment I heard him sing, I was like…Woah, this person could grow into a talented artist.
translations.ko: JIB: 하지만 노래할 때는 정말 매력적이었습니다. JIB: 그가 노래하는 것을 듣는 순간, 저는… 와, 이 친구는 재능 있는 아티스트로 성장할 수 있겠구나 싶었습니다.
translations.id: JIB: Tapi saat dia bernyanyi, dia sangat mempesona. JIB: Saat saya mendengarnya bernyanyi, saya merasa... Wah, orang ini bisa berkembang menjadi artis yang berbakat.
translations.pt: JIB: Mas quando ele cantava, era tão charmoso. JIB: No momento em que o ouvi cantar, pensei... Uau, essa pessoa pode se transformar em um artista talentoso.

transcript.text: JIB: As for NAY, I have to say that his image was very attractive from the beginning. JIB: But being a staff in this field, although his appearance was on point, I was completely unsure about his performance.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: スワン・ネー・ナ・クラップ・トン・ボーク・ワー・ルック・カオ・ナー・ドゥード・ドゥン・タン・テー・トン・テー・ドゥワイ・クワーム・ペン・コン・タム・ガーン・ドーン・ニー・パープ・ダイ・テー・ルアン・パフォーマン・ニ・マイ・マンチャイ・ルーイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : As for NAY , I have to say that his image was very attractive from the beginning . JIB : But being a staff in this field , although his appearance was on point , I was completely unsure about his performance .

translations.ja: ジップ：ネーに関しては、最初からビジュアルが非常に魅力的でした。ただ制作側の視点で見ると、ルックスは完璧でもパフォーマンス面では全く未知数で不安でした。
translations.en: JIB: As for NAY, I have to say that his image was very attractive from the beginning. JIB: But being a staff in this field, although his appearance was on point, I was completely unsure about his performance.
translations.ko: JIB: 네이(NAY)의 경우, 처음부터 이미지가 매우 매력적이었다고 말씀드려야겠네요. JIB: 하지만 이 분야의 스태프 입장에서는 외모는 완벽했지만 퍼포먼스에 대해서는 전혀 확신이 없었습니다.
translations.id: JIB: Sedangkan untuk NAY, harus saya akui bahwa visuelnya sangat menarik sejak awal. JIB: Tapi sebagai staf di bidang ini, meskipun penampilannya pas, saya sama sekali tidak yakin dengan penampilannya.
translations.pt: JIB: Quanto ao NAY, devo dizer que sua imagem era muito atraente desde o início. JIB: Mas sendo parte da equipe nesta área, embora sua aparência estivesse perfeita, eu estava completamente incerta sobre seu desempenho.

transcript.text: JIB: However, NAY has made it this far mostly because of himself. JIB: He was ambitious.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テー・ネー・マー・トゥン・チュット・ニー・ダイ・スワン・ヤイ・マー・チャーク・トゥア・カオ・エン・カオ・ミー・クワーム・タヤンタヤート
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : However , NAY has made it this far mostly because of himself . JIB : He was ambitious .

translations.ja: ジップ：けれど、ネーがここまで来られたのは彼自身の力によるものが大きいです。彼はとにかく向上心が強かった。
translations.en: JIB: However, NAY has made it this far mostly because of himself. JIB: He was ambitious.
translations.ko: JIB: 하지만 네이가 여기까지 온 것은 대부분 그 자신 덕분입니다. JIB: 그는 야망이 있었습니다.
translations.id: JIB: Namun, NAY bisa mencapai titik ini sebagian besar karena dirinya sendiri. JIB: Dia sangat ambisius.
translations.pt: JIB: No entanto, o NAY chegou até aqui principalmente por mérito próprio. JIB: Ele era ambicioso.

transcript.text: JIB: Even when his practice schedule was empty, he still came to the Grammy building almost every day to practice. JIB: He would do anything if that made him catch up with his friends.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ワント・ティー・マイ・ミー・タラーン・ソーム・カオ・ゴー・ヤン・マー・ソーム・ティー・グラミー・クアップ・トゥック・ワン・タム・ヤンガイ・ゴー・ダイ・ハイ・タン・プアン
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : Even when his practice schedule was empty , he still came to the Grammy building almost every day to practice . JIB : He would do anything if that made him catch up with his friends .

translations.ja: ジップ：レッスンの予定が入っていない日でも、ほぼ毎日のようにグラミー本社に来て練習していました。仲間に追いつくためなら何でもやるという姿勢でした。
translations.en: JIB: Even when his practice schedule was empty, he still came to the Grammy building almost every day to practice. JIB: He would do anything if that made him catch up with his friends.
translations.ko: JIB: 연습 일정이 비어있을 때조차도 그는 거의 매일 그래미 빌딩에 나와 연습했습니다. JIB: 친구들을 따라잡을 수만 있다면 무엇이든 할 기세였습니다.
translations.id: JIB: Bahkan ketika jadwal latihannya kosong, dia tetap datang ke gedung Grammy hampir setiap hari untuk berlatih. JIB: Dia akan melakukan apa saja agar bisa mengejar ketertinggalan dari teman-temannya.
translations.pt: JIB: Mesmo quando sua agenda de treinos estava vazia, ele ainda vinha ao prédio da Grammy quase todos os dias para praticar. JIB: Ele faria qualquer coisa para alcançar os amigos.

transcript.text: JIB: His ambition and his dedication make him where he is today.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: クワーム・タヤンタヤート・レ・クワーム・トゥム・テー・コーン・カオ・タム・ハイ・カオ・マー・ユ・ナ・チュット・ニー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : His ambition and his dedication make him where he is today .

translations.ja: ジップ：彼の強い野心とひたむきな努力が、今日の彼を作り上げたんです。
translations.en: JIB: His ambition and his dedication make him where he is today.
translations.ko: JIB: 그의 야망과 헌신이 오늘의 그를 만들었습니다.
translations.id: JIB: Ambisi dan dedikasinya membawanya ke posisinya saat ini.
translations.pt: JIB: Sua ambição e dedicação o fizeram chegar onde está hoje.

transcript.text: JIB: JUNG was the person who thought carefully after he listened to something. JIB: He had to feel that it was right first before he believed and did it. JIB: From his appearance, he had a clean look.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ジャン・チャ・ペン・コン・ティー・ファン・アライ・レオ・キット・タム・クワーム・カオチャイ・カオ・トン・ルー・スック・ワー・チャイ・コーン・カオ・トゥン・チャ・チュア・レ・タム・ルック・パープ・ゴー・チャ・ルック・サアート
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : JUNG was the person who thought carefully after he listened to something . JIB : He had to feel that it was right first before he believed and did it . JIB : From his appearance , he had a clean look .

translations.ja: ジップ：ジャンは何を聞いても深くじっくり考えるタイプでした。自分が納得して「これだ」と感じて初めて信じて行動に移すんです。見た目は爽やかでクリーンな印象でした。
translations.en: JIB: JUNG was the person who thought carefully after he listened to something. JIB: He had to feel that it was right first before he believed and did it. JIB: From his appearance, he had a clean look.
translations.ko: JIB: jung은 무언가를 듣고 신중하게 생각하는 사람이었습니다. JIB: 믿고 행동하기 전에 먼저 그것이 옳다고 느껴야 했습니다. JIB: 겉모습으로 보기에 그는 깔끔한 인상이었습니다.
translations.id: JIB: JUNG adalah orang yang berpikir matang-matang setelah mendengarkan sesuatu. JIB: Dia harus merasa itu benar terlebih dahulu sebelum percaya dan melakukannya. JIB: Dari penampilannya, dia memiliki tampilan yang bersih.
translations.pt: JIB: O JUNG era a pessoa que pensava cuidadosamente depois de ouvir algo. JIB: Ele precisava sentir que era a coisa certa primeiro antes de acreditar e fazer. JIB: De aparência, ele tinha um visual limpo.

transcript.text: JIB: But whenever he raps, I feel his fierceness and that’s what make him charismatic. JIB: He seems like a very attractive person with two personalities.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: テー・ポー・ラップ・レオ・ミー・クワーム・ドゥー・コーン・カオ・マン・タム・ハイ・カオ・ミー・サネー・ドゥー・ペン・コン・ソン・ブクリック・ティー・ナー・ソンチャイ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : But whenever he raps , I feel his fierceness and that ’s what make him charismatic . JIB : He seems like a very attractive person with two personalities .

translations.ja: ジップ：でもラップをすると内に秘めた激しさが現れて、それが彼の大きな魅力になっています。二面性があるとても魅力的な人物に見えます。
translations.en: JIB: But whenever he raps, I feel his fierceness and that’s what make him charismatic. JIB: He seems like a very attractive person with two personalities.
translations.ko: JIB: 하지만 랩을 할 때면 그의 강렬함이 느껴지는데, 그것이 바로 그의 카리스마입니다. JIB: 그는 두 가지 매력을 모두 가진 아주 매력적인 사람처럼 보입니다.
translations.id: JIB: Tapi setiap kali dia ngetes, saya merasakan kesadisannya dan itulah yang membuatnya karismatik. JIB: Dia tampak seperti orang yang sangat menarik dengan dua kepribadian.
translations.pt: JIB: Mas sempre que ele faz rap, sinto sua ferocidade e é isso que o torna carismático. JIB: Ele parece ser uma pessoa muito atraente com duas personalidades.

transcript.text: JIB: As for PLUGGY, he is the the youngest of the group. JIB: We could tell from the first time we met him that he was so innocent, interesting, and had a good voice.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: スワン・プラッギー・ペン・ノン・レック・スット・ヘン・タン・テー・トン・ルーイ・ワー・ミー・クワーム・インノセント・ナー・ソンチャイ・レ・スィアン・ディ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : As for PLUGGY , he is the the youngest of the group . JIB : We could tell from the first time we met him that he was so innocent , interesting , and had a good voice .

translations.ja: ジップ：プラッギーはグループの最年少です。最初に会ったときから純粋無垢で、面白くて、とても良い声を持っているのがわかりました。
translations.en: JIB: As for PLUGGY, he is the the youngest of the group. JIB: We could tell from the first time we met him that he was so innocent, interesting, and had a good voice.
translations.ko: JIB: 플러기(PLUGGY)의 경우, 그룹에서 막내입니다. JIB: 처음 만났을 때부터 아주 순수하고 흥미로우며 좋은 목소리를 가지고 있다는 것을 알 수 있었습니다.
translations.id: JIB: Adapun PLUGGY, dia adalah anggota termuda di grup. JIB: Kami dapat melihat sejak pertama kali bertemu dengannya bahwa dia sangat polos, menarik, dan memiliki suara yang bagus.
translations.pt: JIB: Quanto ao PLUGGY, ele é o mais jovem do grupo. JIB: Pudemos perceber desde a primeira vez que o conhecemos que ele era muito inocente, interessante e tinha uma boa voz.

transcript.text: JIB: His performance wasn’t that eye-catching back then but his figure and smile were so endearing.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: パフォーマン・アアット・チャ・ヤン・マイ・ダイ・ドート・デン・マーク・テー・ルアン・ルパン・ローイ・イム・コーン・カオ・マン・ナー・エン・ドゥー
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : His performance wasn ’t that eye-catching back then but his figure and smile were so endearing .

translations.ja: ジップ：当時のパフォーマンスはまだそこまで目立つものではありませんでしたが、スタイルと笑顔がとにかく愛らしかったんです。
translations.en: JIB: His performance wasn’t that eye-catching back then but his figure and smile were so endearing.
translations.ko: JIB: 그 당시에는 퍼포먼스가 그렇게 눈에 띄지는 않았지만 체격과 미소가 아주 사랑스러웠습니다.
translations.id: JIB: Penampilannya saat itu tidak begitu mencolok, tetapi bentuk tubuh dan senyumannya sangat menawan.
translations.pt: JIB: Seu desempenho não chamava tanta atenção na época, mas sua silhueta e sorriso eram cativantes.

transcript.text: JIB: When he smiled, he had a broad and straight smile, and his eyes sparkled. JIB: We felt that he was another element we were looking for in a Boy Group.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: イム・クワーン・イム・スア・ター・ペン・プラカーイ・ルー・スック・ワー・カオ・ペン・イーク・ヌン・オンプラゴープ・ティー・ラオ・モン・ハー・サムラップ・ボーイグループ
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : When he smiled , he had a broad and straight smile , and his eyes sparkled . JIB : We felt that he was another element we were looking for in a Boy Group .

translations.ja: ジップ：くしゃっと屈託なく笑うと目がキラキラ輝いて。ボーイズグループに求めていたもう一つの大事な要素を彼が持っていると感じました。
translations.en: JIB: When he smiled, he had a broad and straight smile, and his eyes sparkled. JIB: We felt that he was another element we were looking for in a Boy Group.
translations.ko: JIB: 미소 지을 때 크고 바른 미소를 지었으며, 눈이 반짝거렸습니다. JIB: 우리가 보이 그룹에서 찾고 있던 또 다른 요소라는 느낌이 들었습니다.
translations.id: JIB: Saat dia tersenyum, senyumannya lebar dan lurus, serta matanya berbinar. JIB: Kami merasa bahwa dia adalah elemen lain yang kami cari dalam sebuah Boy Group.
translations.pt: JIB: Quando sorria, ele tinha um sorriso largo e sincero, e seus olhos brilhavam. JIB: Sentimos que ele era outro elemento que procurávamos em um Boy Group.

transcript.text: JIB: We wanted a member who brought sunshine to the group. JIB:  At first, PERSES consisted of 4 members, so how could it become 5? JIB: We’d done tons of auditions until finally, we got PALM.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ヤーク・ダイ・スワン・ティー・ペン・スワーン・サワーン・コーン・ウォン・トーン・レーク・パーセス・ミー・シー・コン・レオ・チャ・マー・ペン・ハー・ダイ・ヤンガイ・オージション・パイ・マーク・マーイ・チョン・ダイ・パーム
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JIB : We wanted a member who brought sunshine to the group . JIB : At first , PERSES consisted of 4 members , so how could it become 5 ? JIB : We ’d done tons of auditions until finally , we got PALM .

translations.ja: ジップ：グループを明るく照らす太陽のような存在が欲しかったんです。最初は4人だったPERSESがどうやって5人になったかというと、数え切れないほどのオーディションを重ねて、ついにパームに出会えたんです。
translations.en: JIB: We wanted a member who brought sunshine to the group. JIB: At first, PERSES consisted of 4 members, so how could it become 5? JIB: We’d done tons of auditions until finally, we got PALM.

translations.pt: JIB: Queríamos um membro que trouxesse luz ao grupo. JIB: No início, o PERSES consistia em 4 membros, então como se tornou 5? JIB: Fizemos inúmeras audições até que finalmente conseguimos o PALM.

translations.ja: ジャン: だから最初にお会いした時はどう振る舞えばいいか分からなくて。すごく厳しくて怖い方だったらどうしようと怯えていたんですが、後になって本当のお兄さんみたいな人だと分かりました。
translations.en: JUNG: So, I didn’t know what to do when first I met him. JUNG: I was so scared that he would be a really serious person or that working with him was no joke. JUNG: But later I knew that he was like an older brother.
translations.ko: JUNG: 그래서 처음 만났을 때 어떻게 해야 할지 몰랐습니다. JUNG: 정말 진지한 사람이거나 작업하는 게 장난이 아닐까 봐 너무 겁을 먹었습니다. JUNG: 하지만 나중에 보니 친형 같은 분이라는 것을 알게 되었습니다.
translations.id: JUNG: Jadi, saya tidak tahu harus berbuat apa saat pertama kali bertemu dengannya. JUNG: Saya sangat takut dia akan menjadi orang yang sangat serius atau bekerja dengannya bukanlah hal yang main-main. JUNG: Tapi kemudian saya tahu bahwa dia seperti seorang kakak laki-laki.
translations.pt: JUNG: Então, eu não sabia o que fazer quando o conheci. JUNG: Fiquei com muito medo de que ele fosse uma pessoa muito séria ou que trabalhar com ele não fosse brincadeira. JUNG: Mas depois percebi que ele era como um irmão mais velho.

transcript.text: JUNG: He always collects our information and makes us feel at ease around him. JUNG: As time passed, it was quite easy working with him.
transcript.pronunciation_kana: ピー・カオ・コイ・ゲップ・コームーン・レ・タム・ハイ・ラオ・ルースック・ポン・クラーイ・ポー・ウェーラー・パーン・パイ・コ・タム・ガーン・ドゥアイ・ガーイ・クン・マーク
transcript.pronunciation_roman: JUNG : He always collects our information and makes us feel at ease around him . JUNG : As time passed , it was quite easy working with him .

translations.ja: ジャン: いつも僕たちの特徴を汲み取ってくれて、リラックスした雰囲気を作ってくれます。時間が経つにつれて、とても作業しやすくなりました。
translations.en: JUNG: He always collects our information and makes us feel at ease around him. JUNG: As time passed, it was quite easy working with him.
translations.ko: JUNG: 그는 항상 우리의 정보를 수집하고 우리 편안함을 느낄 수 있게 해주었습니다. JUNG: 시간이 지나면서 그와 함께 일하는 것은 꽤 수월했습니다.
translations.id: JUNG: Dia selalu mengumpulkan informasi tentang kami and membuat kami merasa nyaman di dekatnya. JUNG: Seiring berjalannya waktu, bekerja dengannya cukup mudah.
translations.pt: JUNG: Ele sempre junta nossas informações e nos faz sentir à vontade perto dele. JUNG: Com o passar do tempo, foi bem fácil trabalhar com ele.

translations.en: KRITTIN: After I’d gotten a chance to work with PANOTH, I knew that his perspective on music was extremely good since he looked at it in various ways.
translations.ko: 크릿(KRITTIN): 파놋님과 함께 일할 기회를 얻은 후, 음악을 다양한 각도로 바라보기 때문에 음악에 대한 그의 시각이 엄청나게 뛰어나다는 것을 알게 되었습니다.
translations.id: KRITTIN: Setelah mendapat kesempatan bekerja dengan PANOTH, saya tahu bahwa sudut pandangnya tentang musik sangat bagus karena dia melihatnya dari berbagai cara.
translations.pt: KRITTIN: Depois que tive a chance de trabalhar com o PANOTH, percebi que a perspectiva dele sobre música era extremamente boa, já que ele a enxergava de várias maneiras.

transcript.text: KRITTIN:  He made us see different views of the music field.

translations.en: KRITTIN: He made us see different views of the music field.
translations.ko: 크릿(KRITTIN): 그 덕분에 음악 분야를 다른 시각으로 바라볼 수 있게 되었습니다.
translations.id: KRITTIN: Dia membuat kami melihat sudut pandang yang berbeda di bidang musik.
translations.pt: KRITTIN: Ele nos fez ver diferentes visões do campo musical.
